title: Unambiguous entity identity
statement: The system shall identify every governed engineering entity by an explicit identity that distinguishes it from every other entity in the same governed engineering model.

what.problem: Display names or physical locations can be ambiguous, and duplicate identities can make an engineering reference designate more than one entity.
what.desired_outcome: An identity-based reference unambiguously designates one entity within the governed model, including when several entities share a display name.

why.rationale: Names alone cannot reliably distinguish entities or support durable references.

stakeholders: Reviewers and tools checking model integrity
Readers and tools resolving identity-based references

conditions: When entities enter a governed model and when their identities are used to distinguish or reference them.

contexts: Within one governed engineering model, across entity names, types, and locations.

how.approach: Require an explicit nonempty identity for each accepted entity, reject duplicate identities for distinct entities, and resolve references by identity independently of display names.

how_much.scope: Uniqueness applies within one governed engineering model. It does not require globally unique identities across independent projects or make an entity identity identify a particular content revision.

acceptance_criteria: Every entity accepted into a governed model has an explicit, nonempty identity.
A candidate model containing two distinct entities with the same identity is reported as invalid, even if their names, types, or locations differ.
Two entities may share a display name while retaining distinct identities, and an identity-based reference unambiguously identifies its intended entity.
An identity lookup that matches no entity reports that absence. A lookup encountering multiple entities with the requested identity reports ambiguity and does not arbitrarily select one entity.

sources.basis: Stable identities and references independent of display naming and location.

Apply the renewed REM Scenario Analysis method to the existing IR-001 need; preserve requirement identities and reconcile scenario outcomes with obligations and logical behavior. Confirmation records draft analysis, not approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
